title: Long-lived sampled handlers hold one of the two default analysis permits for their whole lifetime
claim: The analysis permit is acquired in serverHandler.ServeHTTP and released only by the deferred Finish when the handler returns (request/owner.go:65-80,272). With DD_IAST_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS=2 by default, two sampled long-lived handlers (SSE, websocket, long polling, streaming) make every other request capacity-dropped until they close. Not a leak or permanent, but undocumented and able to silently disable IAST for long periods.
